args.query: RSE Canada Group Plan dental coverage

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Employees of the Toronto office are covered by the RSE Canada Group Plan, which provides health, dental and other group benefits for Canadian employees. This summary does not describe the plan in detail. Plan details, claims and eligibility questions for the RSE Canada Group Plan go to HR.
The US plan descriptions in §2 do not apply to Toronto employees, even where the plans have similar names. Toronto employees enrol in the RSE Canada Group Plan through HR when they join, and HR provides the plan booklet and claim forms.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Feature | Dental
Preventive care | Cleanings and check-ups covered in network
Basic and major care | Fillings, crowns and other treatment shared with the plan
You can join the dental plan even if you waive medical coverage, and you can choose a different coverage level for dental than for medical. Details of the dental network are in the plan documents.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
For anything this summary doesn't answer, including claims, plan details and costs, the RSE Canada Group Plan, or your own coverage, contact the HR Service Desk at hr@ridgeline.example or through HR Portal > Ask HR.
This document is a summary. Where it differs from the plan documents, the plan documents apply. HR can explain how the plans work but cannot advise you which plan is best for your personal circumstances.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Benefits eligibility depends on your Employment Type. Full-time employees are eligible for all US plans in §2. Part-time employees are eligible for medical, dental, vision and the 401(k); Ridgeline's employer contribution to medical premiums is pro-rated by scheduled hours. Interns are eligible for the 401(k) only. Contractors are not eligible for Ridgeline benefits. Employees of the Toronto office are covered by the RSE Canada Group Plan instead of the US plans (§5).
Your eligibility is based on the Employment Type on your HR record. If your Employment Type changes, for example from part-time to full-time, your eligibility changes from the date of the change, and you can update your elections within the qualifying life event window (§3.4).

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
For medical, dental and vision you choose one coverage level: employee only, employee plus spouse, employee plus children, or family.
You can choose a different coverage level for each plan, for example family medical coverage and employee-only vision. Your coverage level stays the same for the plan year unless you have a qualifying life event (§3.4).

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Coverage starts on the first day of the month after your hire date. If you enrol within your new-hire window (§3.1) after that date has passed, your coverage is back-dated to the first day of the month after your hire date.
For example, an employee hired in the middle of October is covered from the first day of November once they enrol, even if they enrol a few days into November. Until you enrol, you have no Ridgeline coverage, so enrol early in your window.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Feature | Medical HDHP with HSA
Premiums | Lower premiums, higher deductible
Health savings account (HSA) | Ridgeline contributes $750 a year for employee-only coverage, or $1,500 a year for any coverage that includes family members
Who it suits | Employees who want lower premiums and to save for health costs tax-efficiently
Ridgeline's HSA contribution is paid into your account in instalments through the year, and the account is yours to keep if you leave. You can add your own contributions through payroll. The HDHP pays for preventive care before the deductible is met.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Open enrollment for 2027 runs from November 16 to November 30, 2026. Choices made at open enrollment take effect on January 1, 2027. Open enrollment is the time to join, change or leave a plan for the coming year.
HR sends a reminder before open enrollment starts, with any changes to the plans for the coming year. If you make no changes, your current elections generally continue into the new year. Check your family members and coverage levels each year.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Feature | Life insurance
Coverage | 1× annual base pay
Cost | Company-paid; no employee contribution
Name your beneficiaries in the HR Portal and keep them up to date, especially after a marriage or the birth of a child. Life insurance coverage ends when you leave Ridgeline.

passages.title: Employee Handbook & Code of Conduct
passages.text: Ridgeline is a civil and structural engineering consultancy with about 450 people. We have four offices. Denver, Colorado is our headquarters (America/Denver time). Our other offices are Austin, Texas (America/Chicago), Seattle, Washington (America/Los_Angeles) and Toronto, Ontario (America/ Toronto). Your home office is the office on your HR record. It decides your holiday calendar (RSE-HOL-01 §1.1) and your local core hours. Each office runs its own projects but shares engineering standards, tools and teams across the firm. It is common for a project team to include engineers from more than one office, which is why core hours (§3.2) and shared anchor days matter. Toronto staff follow the Canada holiday calendar; staff in Denver, Austin and Seattle follow the US calendar. Your home office stays the same when you travel or work temporarily from somewhere else.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Expense claims are approved by claim total. Your manager approves claims up to $1,000. Your director approves claims up to $5,000. The VP Finance approves claims above $5,000. See also the Approval Matrix (RSE-APR-01 §4). Questions go to Finance at expenses@ridgeline.example. Approvers check that each item is a genuine business expense, within the limits in this policy and supported by receipts. An approver may approve part of a claim and decline the rest; you will be told which items and why.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Submit claims within 30 days of the expense. Claims older than 60 days are not reimbursed without a director exception. Submitting promptly helps projects bill clients accurately and helps Finance close each month. For a long trip, you may submit claims as you go rather than waiting until you return.

passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: All limits in this policy are in USD. Claims in other currencies are compared with the limits at the card rate or Finance's rate on the expense date. Enter the amount in the currency you paid, and the HR Portal converts it. Card fees for foreign transactions on a personal card are reimbursed if you show them on your statement.

passages.text:
Feature | Medical PPO
Network | In-network and out-of-network providers; lower cost in network
Primary care referral | Not needed to see a specialist
Who it suits | Employees who want the widest choice of providers
Plan-specific costs, deductibles and provider lists are in the plan documents in the HR Portal.
The PPO suits people who want to keep seeing particular doctors, who travel often within the US, or who expect regular care during the year. Your share of the premium is taken from your pay before tax each pay period. You can compare the PPO and the HDHP side by side in the HR Portal before you enrol.
